title: TimeWorld: Towards Action-Conditioned Multimodal World Models for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.34797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting supports decision-making in web applications such as online retail and network management, where planned actions can reshape future dynamics. World models provide a natural paradigm for predicting such action-dependent changes beyond extrapolating historical patterns. However, existing time series world models (TSWMs) typically rely on fixed, domain-specific covariate schemas that limit flexible intervention specification, while multimodal forecasters treat text primarily as passive predictive context. To investigate these gaps, we introduce TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for multimodal TSWMs spanning seven real-world datasets, with textual interventions grounded in recorded action--outcome data. translated_title: TimeWorld：面向时间序列预测的动作条件多模态世界模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测为在线零售和网络管理等Web应用中的决策提供支持，在这些应用中，计划采取的行动可以重塑未来的动态。世界模型为预测此类依赖行动的变化提供了一种自然的范式，超越了简单外推历史模式的方法。然而，现有时间序列世界模型（TSWMs）通常依赖固定的、特定领域的协变量模式，限制了灵活的干预指定方式，而多模态预测器则主要将文本视为被动的预测上下文。为研究这些差距，我们提出了TSWM-Bench，这是一个面向多模态时间序列世界模型的跨领域基准，涵盖七个真实世界数据集，其中的文本干预基于记录的行动-结果数据。我们的评估表明，尽管经过了特定数据集的训练，传统多模态预测器的表现仍不及仅依赖历史数据的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs），而简单的文本前缀适配则能提升预测（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了TSWM-Bench跨领域基准，用于评估基于文本干预的多模态时间序列世界模型，发现传统多模态预测器表现不及仅用历史数据的时间序列基础模型，而简单的文本前缀适配方法可以提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for evaluating multimodal time series world models with textual interventions, revealing that conventional multimodal forecasters underperform history-only time series foundation models, while simple text-prefix adaptations improve forecasting performance.
